name: RiverField Studio Director
summary: Material Planner driven H3 director: media bin, per-segment prompts and windows, two-stage sampling, finite segment rendering with sound.

source.notes: MiniMaxH3TimelinePlanner fed by the RiverField H3 Material Planner node (custom_nodes/riverfield-h3-planner): its timeline_data document is built from the app fields, so every planner option is a normal input. H3 SLA runs on comfy-kitchen Sol-Attn (local/patch-h3-sla-solattn.py).

inputs.label: Global prompt
inputs.help: Used for the current generation window and reused by every segment whose own prompt is empty.

inputs.label: Segment duration (s)
inputs.help: Generation duration of one segment, rounded to an H3-legal 5+17n frame count. Total ≈ segments × duration − seams.

inputs.label: Segments
inputs.help: Material segments: each gets its own window and its own line in the segment prompts.

inputs.label: Segment prompts
inputs.help: One prompt per segment, one per line. Empty lines fall back to the global prompt.

inputs.label: Timeline start (s)
inputs.help: Where the generation window starts on the material timeline.

inputs.label: Two-stage sampling (SelfLift)
inputs.help: Low-res pass, latent lift, then a few high-res steps.

inputs.label: Latent upscaler
inputs.help: H3 latent upscaler used by the two-stage pass.

inputs.label: High-res steps
inputs.help: Steps spent at high resolution; must stay below the scheduler's step count.

inputs.label: Advanced: raw timeline JSON
inputs.help: Non-empty: replaces every planner field above and is passed to the Material Planner unchanged.

inputs.label: Resolution (MP)
inputs.help: Rounded to the dimension multiple below.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: -1 picks a random seed

inputs.label: Sparse attention (Sol-Attn)
inputs.help: Off: dense attention (much slower) for A/B tests.

inputs.label: Sparse attention: detail
inputs.help: Fraction of key blocks skipped. Lower = more exact blocks = better detail, slower.

inputs.label: Extra dense step indices
inputs.help: Comma-separated step numbers that must run dense, e.g. 0,3.

inputs.label: Codec
inputs.help: h264/av1 need mp4 or mkv; prores needs mov or mkv. Encoding mode stays automatic.

notes: Agent notes. Every input is optional: an empty media slot is ignored. Two ways to drive the Material Planner. (1) Simple: global_prompt + duration (seconds per segment) + segment_count + optional segment_prompts (one prompt per line); the builder splits the duration into equal H3-legal windows and assigns every picture/audio to every segment. (2) Exact: segment_windows, a JSON string {"windows":[{"start":0,"end":192,"prompt":"shot","images":[0],"audios":[0]}],"videos":[{"index":0,"start":0,"duration":5,"trimStart":0,"referenceMode":"guide"}],"audios":[{"index":0,"start":0,"duration":5,"trimStart":0}]}. Frames are 24 fps, each window length should be 5+17n, windows may overlap (default 39-frame seam). images/audios are 0-based indices into image1..image9 / audio1..audio3; videos are timeline clips indexed into video1..video3 and are sliced per segment by their time window. Files go through run_app.files (absolute paths) under the ids image1..image9, video1..video3, audio1..audio3. audio_mode=locked keeps the source waveform, video_audio carries the videos' sound. two_stage + upscaler + high_steps enable SelfLift. detail is the sparse-attention sparsity (0.9 fast … 0.5 detailed).
